name: fallout-ttrpg
description: Foundry VTT v14 game system for the fan-made Fallout TTRPG by Arcane Arcade (XP to Level 3), v2.0

scripts.build: node scripts/build-tokens.mjs && vite build && node scripts/build-packs.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run lint && npm run build
scripts.package: npm run verify && rm -f fallout-ttrpg-system.zip && cd dist && zip -qr ../fallout-ttrpg-system.zip .
